answer: Random peer audit stops a nebula of fake identities flooding the network. Each new agent locks twice its 30-day earnings as bond for 20 epochs. Auditors, drawn at random like a river picking stones, check the agent's work and referral graph. One proven fake, a saffron-priced fraud, burns its bond and slashes the referrer. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 300 = 300,000 POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, earns undiluted rewards.
